as-dev-create-platform-bound-skill.README.md:
# Create a platform-bound Skill

Create one new Skill for inspecting Linux systemd service state with
`systemctl` 255+. Name it `linux-systemd-service-state-inspection-tool` and
declare Linux, systemctl 255+, and offline operation in compatibility metadata.
The package starts empty. Do not install anything or access the network. Report
missing evidence instead of guessing and return complete changed files only.

as-dev-no-platform-requirement.README.md:
# Create a portable text Skill

Create a generic Skill that rewrites supplied text for clarity. It has no
platform, binary, service, or network requirement, so do not invent
compatibility metadata. Name it `generic-text-clarity-rewriting-skill`, preserve
the supplied text's meaning, never invent missing content, and return complete
changed files only.

as-dev-preserve-runtime-metadata.README.md:
# Preserve existing metadata

Add one bounded instruction that distinguishes observed facts from hypotheses
before reaching a conclusion. Do not change the existing name, compatibility,
license, reference file, or package layout.
as-dev-preserve-runtime-metadata.skills/incident-evidence-review/SKILL.md:
---
name: incident-evidence-review
description: Review local incident evidence and report a bounded conclusion.
license: Apache-2.0
compatibility: macOS 13+ or Ubuntu 22.04+, Python 3.12+, and local read access
---

Inspect the local incident evidence. Cite each opened path and report missing
evidence rather than guessing.
as-dev-preserve-runtime-metadata.skills/incident-evidence-review/referenc:
# Operations

Inputs are local and immutable. Do not install packages.

as-dev-repair-runtime-metadata.README.md:
# Repair compatibility metadata

The existing Skill is behaviorally correct, but its runtime requirements are
buried in this document. Linux, jq 1.7+, and offline operation are required.
Preserve the Skill name and instructions while repairing only metadata.
as-dev-repair-runtime-metadata.skills/offline-release-audit/SKILL.md:

name: offline-release-audit
description: Audit a local release bundle without network access.
compatibility:
